subject: Myth & Symbolism
subcategory: The World Tree and Cosmic Maps
title: The Underworld Below
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: The Underworld Below.

hook.text: The dead go down. Hades is below. Sheol is below. Hell is below. Depth equals death in almost every culture.

buildup.text: Bodies are buried in the ground. Caves lead downward. The association between depth and death is physical.

discovery.text: In Mesoamerica, cenotes—deep sinkholes—were entrances to Xibalba, the underworld. Geology shaped theology.

twist.text: Not all underworlds are punishing. The Australian Aboriginal underworld is a source of life—seeds come from below.

climax.text: Below is where things are hidden, buried, and transformed. The underworld is the unconscious of the cosmos.

punchline.text: Dig deep enough. You'll find the dead.

quiz.question: What natural feature served as an entrance to the Mesoamerican underworld?
